Even though it was before their debut, the stands were packed with
general spectators, fellow Umamusume, and sharp-eyed Trainers.

—And now, they enter the final stretch!!
Ryan, having fought desperately to make up for a late start, moves into second place!

"Just that"...? Ryan-chan trains so hard every single day,
you didn't have to put it like that...
Why... did you come to Tracen Academy?

In the end, Mejiro Ryan quickly walked away as well,
before I could even have a proper conversation...
(—Clack!!)
Whoa!? Ah... McQueen-chan!

Debuts aren't easy to win when it comes to the selection races!
Everyone's dead serious, burning with the drive to make their debut no matter what.
(Riding on pride, huh...)
"Why"... huh...
Ngh, ah...! The girl in the lead, she's the one from earlier...
With a reason as shallow as that, it makes sense, doesn't it...

Ahaha... I run laps around the academy grounds every day,
so I end up greeting people and making a lot of friends along the way.
Ryaaan, we're rooting for you!! You've got this!!
Show us that trademark powerful running of yours!!
Oh, McQueen-chan! You came to watch!

Ryan-chan seemed a bit off earlier.
How should I put it—
Oh!? Mejiro Ryan is significantly delayed out of the gate!
Pardon me. I shall go and speak with her for a moment.

...What's so funny at a time like this?
This is an important race. Take it seriously.

Huh!? Ah, wait up, wait up!
If you're going to see Ryan-chan, I'm coming too!

The finish post is right before them! Ryan gives chase! Ryan gives chase!
Ryan is in a desperate pursuit, but—
Ngh!? D-Damn it...!!
...Hmph.

And when people see Ryan-chan working that hard every single day,
everybody naturally wants to cheer her on♪
Eh, ah... S-Sorry!

Ah... sorry about that. She comes from a pretty prominent household.
She's carrying the pride of her family name to make her debut, so her nerves are on edge.
The pride of her family...

Yes, as I will be running in the next race.
Setting that aside...

Maybe the difference came down to heart.
After all, at the end of the day... I just happen to like exercising, that's all.

Alright, it's almost time to run...!
I wonder how far the current me can go... Hehe!

Whoa... thank you so much, everyone!!
I'll give it my all!!
Ngh... Yeah, what is it, McQueen?
That's...

The day of the selection races, where Umamusume showcase their abilities
to secure scout offers from Trainers.
Excuse me, Ryan.

It feels a little embarrassing hearing that...
but having folks cheer for me means a lot. I gotta do my best!

Ah, no, um... yeah, I just haven't trained enough!
Not just my body, but my heart too. I have to work way harder!
You can still catch up, don't give uuup--!!
Yeah! Good luck out there--!!

Ahaha, looks like our showdown will have to wait for next time!
Well, my race is coming right up. Catch you later, Ines!

What do you mean, "what's up"?! Ryan-chan, what happened out there?
The start and the final stretch didn't look like you at all.
Whoa... Ryan-chan's as popular as ever~.
Let's go, let's go, Ryaaaan!!

...My apologies. That was an impolite question to ask.
If you will excuse me.

Yeah. I can't let myself fall behind either!
...Though my turn isn't until the next race.

Together with Ines Fujin and Mejiro McQueen,
I decided to head over to Mejiro Ryan.

Huh, Trainer, Ines... even McQueen?!
What is everyone doing here together...?

--You lacked your usual sharpness.
That run was quite unlike you, Ryan.
Oof, hearing that from you really stings, McQueen...
Hah, hah, hah...!! Damn it...!!
And now, all the horse girls have entered the starting gate!
Hmmmm... wait...?

--She won't make it!! The leader crosses the fiiinish line now!!
Mejiro Ryan finishes in second place!!

Mejiro Ryan went off to prepare for her race,
but watching her demeanour...
